subject: social_science
chapter_title: The Price Puzzle: What Drives the Market

concepts.title: Demand and Its Determinants
concepts.definition: Demand is the quantity of a good buyers are willing and able to purchase at a price: it rises as price falls and falls as price rises, while income, tastes, prices of related goods and expectations shift the whole demand.
concepts.key_idea: Price down, demand up: the law of demand, with income and taste as its partners.
concepts.textbook_ref: iest109.txt opening sections (factors that influence demand)
question_patterns: what is meant by demand - state the law of demand
which factors influence the demand for a good
why does demand fall when price rises - explain
how does a rise in income change the demand for the given good
distinguish change in demand and change in quantity demanded
draw and read a demand curve for the given data

solution_steps.explain: Higher price shrinks the quantity demanded, lower price expands it.
Income, tastes, related goods' prices and expectations shift demand.
The demand curve slopes downward from left to right.

concepts.title: Supply and Its Determinants
concepts.definition: Supply is the quantity sellers offer for sale at a price: higher prices invite larger supply, while costs of inputs, technology, number of sellers and expectations determine how much the market receives at each price.
concepts.key_idea: Price up, supply up: sellers respond to reward, costs and technology shape capacity.
concepts.textbook_ref: iest109.txt sections on supply and its factors
question_patterns: what is meant by supply - state the law of supply
which factors influence the supply of a good
why does supply rise when price rises - explain
how does technology change the supply of the given good
distinguish change in supply and change in quantity supplied
draw and read a supply curve for the given data

solution_steps.explain: Higher prices make production more rewarding.
Input costs, technology and seller numbers shift supply.
The supply curve slopes upward from left to right.

concepts.title: Market Equilibrium - Where Price Settles
concepts.definition: Demand and supply together solve the price puzzle: the equilibrium price is where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied; a price above it leaves surplus and pushes price down, a price below leaves shortage and pushes price up.
concepts.key_idea: Surplus presses price down, shortage pushes it up: equilibrium is where they balance.
concepts.textbook_ref: iest109.txt sections on equilibrium of demand and supply
question_patterns: what is market equilibrium - explain with a diagram
what happens to price when demand exceeds supply
how does a bumper crop change the equilibrium price
find the equilibrium price from the given demand and supply schedules
why is the equilibrium price called the market clearing price
trace the adjustment when a festival raises demand

solution_steps.explain: Check where demanded and supplied quantities agree.
Above equilibrium there is surplus; below, shortage.
Price moves until the quantities match again.
